gaps.sentence: The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.

gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).

gaps.explanation: 'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.

gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.
